overview: Example order analytics catalog. Adapt the fixed query, object references and business definitions to this data source before trial and publication.

entries.name: Order amount
entries.description: Amount recorded by the order system. Define currency, refunds and recognition rules for your organization.
entries.grain: order; time-series examples aggregate by the stated query grain
entries.caveats: Do not sum across currencies. This example is not a financial reporting policy.

entries.name: Read order amounts
entries.description: Read an approved native query using named template parameters.

template.query_json: {"language": "flux", "query": "from(bucket:\"orders\") |> range(start:-7d) |> filter(fn:(r)=>r._measurement == \"payments\" and r.region == params.region) |> aggregateWindow(every:1d,fn:sum)", "named_params": {"region": ""}}
template.result_description: Native result structure. Integers, decimals, timestamps and binary values retain the database adapter encoding.
